purpose: Construct real 32-byte SHA-256 inputs reaching prescribed working states after rounds 0..7; exclude state-only unreachable-state assumptions at this boundary.
targets: all-zero, all-one, 24 lane boundaries, 256 random eight-word states
acceptance: Every constructed message reaches its target in raw and O2 instrumented existing Wasm; complete SHA-256 agrees with Python hashlib, Node crypto and unchanged plain Wasm.
negative_control: Reverse bytes within each message word; require at least one target mismatch in each instrumented build.
capture: After incrementing round index to 8, store locals a..h at memory 640..671; do not change original round calculations.
budget: 20 minutes local work; 60 seconds per subprocess; 282 targets, two instrumented builds and unchanged raw baseline
